versions.changelog:
- Initial release of verifyguard, an AI-powered pre-publication inspection tool.
- Automatically checks blog posts or task submissions for content completeness, link availability, sensitive information leaks, and formatting compliance.
- Original implementation inspired by Claude Code Verify, built with Python and requests.
- Provides command-line tools to run individual or full checks on Markdown files.
- Assesses security, link validity, completeness, and formatting with severity levels.
